text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', everyone! Let's get this party
started!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thought I'd drop by on my day off to
watch some races! Running freestyle
races is great, but
watching them's the
best too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Freestyle racers hold themselves with so
much
pride...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Just watching them makes me wanna run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm so fired up now, I think I'm gonna cut
loose on
the track today! Let's have a
good one, everyone!
